driverDashboard.title: [ar] Welcome back, {{name}}
driverDashboard.subtitle: [ar] Manage your loads and earnings.
driverDashboard.notVisible: [ar] You’re not accepting loads right now
driverDashboard.noLoadsBody: [ar] Go available and the admin will match you with a nearby shipment — especially useful for your return leg.

shipperDashboard.title: [ar] Welcome back, {{name}}
shipperDashboard.noShipmentsBody: [ar] Post a shipment when you need a truck — for a raw load or once an order is ready to go out.
shipperDashboard.noOrdersBody: [ar] Once your products go live, buyer orders will show up here for you to confirm and ship.
shipperDashboard.errorGeneric: [ar] Could not load your dashboard data. These endpoints are next in line to build.

buyerDashboard.title: [ar] My orders
buyerDashboard.subtitle: [ar] Your past and current orders.
buyerDashboard.reorderNote: [ar] None of the items from that order are available right now.
buyerDashboard.reorderConfirm: [ar] This will replace the items currently in your cart. Continue?
buyerDashboard.noOrdersBody: [ar] Your past and current orders will show up here once you place one.

login.title: [ar] Log in to Cargozents
login.subtitle: [ar] Access your dashboard as a buyer, shipper, driver, or admin.
login.errorGeneric: [ar] Login failed. Check your details and try again.
login.errorRouting: [ar] Routing error: User role could not be verified.

agencyDashboard.title: [ar] Welcome back, {{name}}
agencyDashboard.subtitle: [ar] Managing agency logistics and active vehicle tracking.

adminDashboard.title: [ar] Admin overview
adminDashboard.subtitle: [ar] Assign trucks, verify drivers, keep the network moving.
adminDashboard.nothingWaitingBody: [ar] Shipment requests needing a driver assignment will queue up here.
adminDashboard.noDriversWaitingBody: [ar] New driver document submissions will show up here for approval.

availableTrucks.title: [ar] Available Trucks
availableTrucks.subtitle: [ar] Your fleet — vehicles registered under your agency.
availableTrucks.noLocations: [ar] None of your trucks have a location set yet — use "Set truck locations" above to place them on the map.
availableTrucks.locationsCount_one: [ar] {{count}} of {{total}} truck have a set location.
availableTrucks.locationsCount_other: [ar] {{count}} of {{total}} trucks have a set location.
availableTrucks.errorGeneric: [ar] Could not load your fleet right now.
availableTrucks.errorAdd: [ar] Could not add truck right now.
availableTrucks.errorUpdate: [ar] Could not update that truck right now.
availableTrucks.errorRemove: [ar] Could not remove that truck right now.
availableTrucks.noTrucksBody: [ar] Register a vehicle to your fleet so it can be matched to shipments.

driverSettings.title: [ar] Driver Settings
driverSettings.subtitle: [ar] Control your duty status, custom map navigation units, and road alerts.
driverSettings.activeDutyDesc: [ar] Toggle on to appear online and accept backhaul cargo matches.
driverSettings.audioAlertsDesc: [ar] Play a loud ringtone whenever a high-match route is offered.
driverSettings.autoNavigateDesc: [ar] Instantly pull up maps right after accepting a cargo load.
driverSettings.gpsSyncDesc: [ar] Allow dispatchers and buyers to track your truck location during a job.
driverSettings.nightModeDesc: [ar] Switch to a dark-charcoal UI to prevent eye fatigue while driving at night.

driverLoads.title: [ar] Available loads
driverLoads.subtitle: [ar] Loads assigned to you, awaiting response or in progress.
driverLoads.notVisible: [ar] You’re not accepting loads right now
driverLoads.nothingWaitingBody: [ar] When admin assigns you a load, it'll show up here for you to accept or reject.
driverLoads.noActiveLoadsBody: [ar] Loads you've accepted will show up here until they're delivered.

shipperSettings.title: [ar] Shipper Settings
shipperSettings.subtitle: [ar] Control your system preferences, API integrations, and display adjustments.
shipperSettings.milestoneAlertsDesc: [ar] Send real-time alerts whenever custom checks, pickups, or deliveries happen.
shipperSettings.erpSyncDesc: [ar] Restrict third-party software from fetching invoice and tracking data logs.
shipperSettings.darkModeDesc: [ar] Switch between standard light screen and cozy dark-room dashboard mode.

adminSettings.title: [ar] Admin Settings
adminSettings.subtitle: [ar] Control platform-wide configuration, moderation rules, and access policies.
adminSettings.newRegistrationsDesc: [ar] Allow new buyers, shippers, drivers, and agencies to sign up.
adminSettings.autoVerifyDriversDesc: [ar] Skip manual document review for drivers who were previously approved.
adminSettings.maintenanceModeDesc: [ar] Show a maintenance banner and pause new shipment/order matching platform-wide.
adminSettings.autoEscalateDesc: [ar] Flag complaints left open for more than 48 hours for priority review.
adminSettings.requireDocReviewDesc: [ar] Block a vehicle from accepting shipments until its documents are admin-verified.
adminSettings.twoFactorDesc: [ar] Require a secondary sign-in step for all admin accounts.
adminSettings.darkModeDesc: [ar] Switch between bright daylight screen and dark-charcoal mode.
